components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA on marketing and forms.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 1rem; font-family: var(--font-noto-sans-georgian), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #fff; background: var(--primary, #1d4ed8); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius, 0.75rem); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, #1d4ed8), white 20%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #1d4ed8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 1rem; font-family: var(--font-noto-sans-georgian), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--foreground, #12151a); background: var(--background, #f5f6f8); border: 1px solid var(--border, #e0e3e9); border-radius: var(--radius, 0.75rem); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted, #dbeafe); color: var(--foreground, #12151a); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #1d4ed8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Section Label
components.css: .ds-section-label { margin: 0 0 0.75rem; font-family: var(--font-noto-sans-georgian), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--primary, #1d4ed8); }

components.name: Site Header
components.html: მთავარინამუშევრები
components.css: .ds-site-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; height: 4rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--background, #f5f6f8), transparent 25%); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--border, #e0e3e9), transparent 20%); } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font-family: var(--font-noto-sans-georgian), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-slate, #4a5160); text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--foreground, #12151a); } .ds-nav-link-active { color: var(--foreground, #12151a); } .ds-nav-link-active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0.75rem; right: 0.75rem; bottom: 0; height: 1px; background: var(--primary, #1d4ed8); }

components.name: CTA Band
components.description: Ink closing section with electric glow.
components.css: .ds-cta-band { position: relative; overflow: hidden; padding: 5rem 1.5rem; background: var(--ink, #0e1116); color: var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-cta-band::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 0%, var(--cta-glow, rgb(37 99 235 / 0.22)) 0%, transparent 50%); pointer-events: none; } .ds-cta-title { position: relative; margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-noto-sans-georgian), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.035em; line-height: 1.05; }

narrative.overview: A precision Georgian studio surface: calm off-white or charcoal field, graphite type, one electric-blue voice for action. Marketing persuades with real portfolio proof; admin and portal operate with shadcn clarity. Light is default; dark is first-class. Ink bands anchor closure.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite + electric blue; Noto Sans Georgian throughout
Open grids over marketing card boxes
Hero portfolio in device chrome with mark/cube/orbit toggle

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Electric blue on primary actions and labels—not full-page gradients.

rules.name: The Ink Anchor Rule
rules.body: Footer and CTA bands stay ink regardless of theme.

rules.name: The Georgian-Only Rule
rules.body: Never use Latin-only display fonts for Georgian UI.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Shadows only for elevation or scroll state.

dos: Do use semantic tokens for light/dark coherence
Do use SectionLabel + display headline pattern
donts: Don't use purple gradients or cream-serif templates
Don't show fake metrics or testimonials
Don't ignore dark mode on public, admin, or portal
